messages:
julia: Quick follow-up from the metering postmortem — 3/19 ingest stall caused delayed token ingestion and a few invoice mismatches. I sketched owners + next steps below. Please ack or reassign by EOD PT. :ear:

omar: Please attach impacted accounts/invoices list. Need to coordinate with CS.

julia: Attached export: `metering_delay_2026-03-19.csv`. Query: `select account_id, invoice_id, sum(delta_tokens) as delta from metering_events where ingest_status='delayed' and date(ts)='2026-03-19' group by account_id, invoice_id order by delta desc limit 100;`

sara: I'll own the replay/backfill worker and make sure it's idempotent. Plan: dry-run on staging -> reconcile -> write to ledger during maintenance window. ETA 36h.

ops-review: Add verification: aggregate(events) vs ledger.tokens_by_account; surface any mismatch > 0.5% per account. Also suggest alert when `metering.ingest.lag > 300s` and `billing.token_mismatch_pct > 0.5` for 10m.

julia: Owners & thresholds (short):
- Replay/backfill (owner: sara) — include idempotency marker and dry-run report.
- Ledger write + rollback plan (owner: omar; reviewer: ops-review). Prepare DB snapshot + idempotent patch.
- Invoice corrections & CS comms (owner: julia). Auto-credit threshold: <$400 -> credit next invoice; >=$400 -> reissue. Finance sign-off for credits >$2500.
- Monitoring + recurrence detection (owner: ops-review).

omar: Dry-run snippet from staging:```
[2026-03-22T02:14:07Z] dry-run replay account=781 events=3120 tokens_delta=3120
[2026-03-22T02:14:09Z] reconcile: ledger_before=101200 ledger_expected=104320 mismatch=3120 (3.08%) -> flag for manual review
```

sara: Note: for accounts with partial failures we'll prefer targeted credits to avoid touching historical accounting periods. Will add `replay_id` and `replay_checksum` to audit logs.

finance-leads: Approve auto-credit threshold at $400 and exec approval for >$2500. Please include projected $ impact per account.

julia: Next steps checklist: 1) sara posts full dry-run report + list of accounts with mismatch >0.5%; 2) omar posts rollback + snapshot plan; 3) julia publishes invoice mapping + CS templates; 4) ops-review creates alerts and schedules test. Next update by 2026-03-23 18:00 UTC.

ledger-bot: Incident BLG-2026-03-19-LAG recorded: owners assigned (sara, omar, julia, ops-review). Reminder: next update due 2026-03-23T18:00:00Z.

sara: :white_check_mark: I'll post dry-run CSV and reconciliation sheet by tomorrow morning.

omar: :white_check_mark: I'll draft rollback steps and share snapshots.

julia: Thanks — react :thumbsup: when you formally accept task so I can lock the action tracker.

ops-review: :thumbsup:

finance-leads: :thumbsup:
